Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

%TEI.corpus

TEI.corpus (TEI corpora DTD fragment) controls the inclusion, in the DTD, of element and attribute declarations for the description of corpora.
Note

To include elements and attributes for corpora in the DTD, the user should declare this entity with a value of ‘INCLUDE’; this will override the default.
Declaration <!ENTITY % TEI.corpus 'IGNORE' >
See further 3.5 Global Attributes; 3.6 The TEI2.DTD File
